chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
The private parts of the women of my nation are forbidden to the men of my nation.

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, who conveys divine guidance
key_terms.مَحَاشُّ: Private parts or intimate bodily areas

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the prohibition of women to men outside lawful relations?
ai.summary: This hadith states the prohibition concerning the intimate parts of women in relation to men of the Muslim community. It expresses a legal and moral boundary tied to chastity, lawful relations, and the protection of honor.
